description: Per-residue conservation of CG42404 PPPY and flanks across Drosophila and Insecta
code:
import requests, re, os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter

OUT="/agent/jobs/6811dc4d-ddff-4159-9963-5139baa317dd/provenance"
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9VFA8.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

def fetch(q):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,organism_name,length,sequence","format":"json","size":500},timeout=300)
    rows=[]
    for e in r.json().get("results",[]):
        s=e["sequence"]["value"]; pp=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"PP.Y",s)]
        rows.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],org=e["organism"]["scientificName"],L=len(s),
                         npp=len(pp),pos=pp[0] if pp else np.nan,seq=s))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

ins=fetch("(xref:panther-PTHR15256) AND (taxonomy_id:50557)"); ins=ins[ins.L>=300]
dro=fetch("(xref:panther-PTHR15256) AND (taxonomy_id:7215)"); dro=dro[dro.L>=600].drop_duplicates("org")
W=10; ref=seq[193-1-W : 193-1+4+W]
print("Dmel window 183-206:", ref)

wins={}
for _,r in dro.iterrows():
    m=re.search(r"PP.Y", r["seq"])
    if m and m.start()-W>=0:
        w=r["seq"][m.start()-W:m.start()+4+W]
        if len(w)==len(ref): wins[r["org"]]=w
print("Drosophila species with window:", len(wins))
ident=[np.mean([w[c]==ref[c] for w in wins.values()]) for c in range(len(ref))]

iw=[]
for _,r in ins[ins.npp>0].iterrows():
    m=re.search(r"PP.Y", r["seq"])
    if m and m.start()-W>=0:
        w=r["seq"][m.start()-W:m.start()+4+W]
        if len(w)==len(ref): iw.append(w)
icnt=[Counter(x[c] for x in iw) for c in range(len(ref))]
ifrac=[c[ref[j]]/len(iw) for j,c in enumerate(icnt)]
pos=list(range(193-W,193+4+W))
cons=pd.DataFrame({"position":pos,"Dmel_residue":list(ref),
                   "frac_identical_Drosophila_n%d"%len(wins):np.round(ident,3),
                   "frac_identical_Insecta_n%d"%len(iw):np.round(ifrac,3),
                   "Insecta_modal":[c.most_common(1)[0][0] for c in icnt],
                   "Insecta_modal_frac":[round(c.most_common(1)[0][1]/len(iw),3) for c in icnt]})
print(cons.to_string(index=False))
print("\nDrosophila: mean identity window %.3f ; PPPY core %.3f"%(np.mean(ident),np.mean(ident[W:W+4])))
print("Insecta:    mean identity window %.3f ; PPPY core %.3f"%(np.mean(ifrac),np.mean(ifrac[W:W+4])))
cons.to_csv(f"{OUT}/cg42404_ppxy_conservation.csv", index=False)
ins[["acc","org","L","npp","pos"]].to_csv(f"{OUT}/insecta_PTHR15256_fulllength.csv", index=False)
dro[["acc","org","L","npp","pos"]].to_csv(f"{OUT}/drosophila_PTHR15256.csv", index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,6.6),sharex=True)
axes[0].bar(pos,ident,color=["#E45756" if 193<=p<=196 else "#4C78A8" for p in pos])
axes[0].set_ylabel("identity to D. melanogaster"); axes[0].set_ylim(0,1.05)
axes[0].set_title(f"CG42404 PPPY region conservation, Drosophila genus (n={len(wins)} species)")
axes[1].bar(pos,ifrac,color=["#E45756" if 193<=p<=196 else "#72B7B2" for p in pos])
axes[1].set_ylabel("identity to D. melanogaster"); axes[1].set_ylim(0,1.05)
axes[1].set_xlabel("residue position in D. melanogaster CG42404 (Q9VFA8)")
axes[1].set_title(f"Same window, Insecta DGCR2/IDD family (n={len(iw)} proteins)")
for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xticks(pos); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{r}\n{p}" for p,r in zip(pos,ref)],fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
